order: Staff the five remaining evidence-band seats: Scout, Researcher, LC Analyst, Investigator, and Archivist. Ship exactly six role files, since Archivist splits into two lane files — documents and images — rather than one file with two variants, because each lane is its own single casting with no mirror rung. The Scout file must be renamed to avoid colliding with the existing top-level scout file already in the repository; it may never ship under the plain name. Carry the Investigator's read-only tool restriction over from the alias it is built from, unchanged. For Researcher and LC Analyst, ship only the primary launcher file for now and leave the mirror rung unshipped — but that gap must be recorded explicitly in the band record, never silently skipped. Update the roster README and the band record to capture every naming and rung decision made here, and leave exercising and reviewing these seats for a later stage only.
claims: Shipped six role files — scout, researcher, lc-analyst, investigator, archivist-documents, and archivist-images — plus updates to the roster README and the band record: 8 files changed, 527 insertions, 1 deletion. The scout file is renamed to avoid a collision with the existing top-level file; investigator carries the read-only tool pin from its source alias unchanged; researcher and lc-analyst ship primary-only, with the missing mirror rung recorded as a gap in the band record.
